name: Somchai Chaisongkram
bio:
Somchai Chaisongkram, a veteran of security operations, brings nearly two decades of experience to Eurofarma RC. His journey began in law enforcement, where he developed a keen eye for detail and a proactive approach to risk management. Driven by a lifelong passion for motorsport, he transitioned into the racing world, initially overseeing security for smaller touring car teams before rising through the ranks.

At Eurofarma RC, Somchai is responsible for the comprehensive security of the team's assets, personnel, and data. He emphasizes preventative measures, implementing robust protocols and training programs to mitigate potential threats. His visionary leadership style encourages his team to anticipate challenges and develop innovative solutions. Somchai’s meticulous nature and dedication to excellence make him a vital asset, ensuring the team operates safely and securely, allowing them to focus on achieving victory on the track.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: A man of medium build with a stern but reassuring presence.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook and pen.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers when deep in thought.
Insists on conducting security briefings in the team garage, regardless of the location.
